name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno, Nevada-based mineral royalty and exploration company focused on acquiring and creating royalties and streams on gold properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company operates a three-pronged business model encompassing royalty creation and acquisition, precious metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. Its portfolio includes an NSR royalty on the Olinghouse gold project in Nevada and an earn-in interest in the Lapon Canyon project in the Walker Lane trend.
